HTTP_PROXY_RESPONSE
Description
This iRules event triggered when the response from the remote HTTP
proxy is received. Triggered when the response to HTTP Proxy chaining
CONNECT request is received in the HTTP_PROXY_CONNECT filter. This
event allows inspection of the CONNECT response headers. The
“
HTTP::proxy
chain retry” command may be used to retry a failed
request.
Examples
when
HTTP_PROXY_RESPONSE
{
log
local0.
"HTTP Proxy response:"
[
HTTP
::
response
]
}
